thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread: define a minimal, customer-friendly pilot playbook for Optimize recommendations (batching / caching / quant). Keep scope small and reversible.

sam - Eng: Agreed. Tech constraints: start int8 only, per-tenant feature flag, runtime tags for {quant_profile, batch_hint, cache_hint}.

li - ML: Quality gates: per-tenant canonical eval + sampled A/B. Two triggers: concordance drop >1.5% OR live mismatch rate >1% -> auto-pause.

maria - Solutions: Customers want explainability. Add an "explain" payload: reason, estimated savings, observed concordance delta, and an opt-out link.

ux - Design: Console microcopy: 1-line reason + "revert" button. Keep UI minimal.

devops-bot: deploy 3210000120 -> canary to optimize-pilot pool

sam - Eng: Suggested launch criteria (pilot): median token savings >=7%, concordance delta <=1.5%, error rate +<=0.1% over 24h, rollback runbook validated.

li - ML: Add per-sample surprise filter: suppress quant rec if token-level entropy spikes beyond threshold.

eng-obs: We'll ship a dashboard tile: tokens saved, p95 latency delta, concordance trend, and a per-tenant rollback action. Telemetry sampling @10% for traces.

maria - Solutions: Pilot candidates: AcmeHealth (explicit opt-in), ComposeAI, TutorLabs. I'll draft customer comms and short FAQ.

anya - PM: Rollout stages: alpha internal -> closed pilot (3 tenants) -> GA opt-in. Regulated tenants default to opt-in. Keep contracts explicit.

sam - Eng: Implementation notes: feature flags + simple rule engine for gating. Emit audit events for every automated decision.

li - ML: Eval-triggered alerts: hook into the eval pipeline; if daily concordance drops > threshold, open ticket + notify tenant admin.

maria - Solutions: Also add a small A/B harness to measure downstream customer KPIs (task success proxy) for the pilot.

anya - PM: Owners & short dates: maria outreach + prompts by Tue, sam runtime tags + canary by Fri, li eval hook by Fri, eng-obs dashboard stub by Mon. Reconvene Wed 11am.

ux - Design: I'll prepare the explainer copy and revert UX.

sam - Eng: Risk: GPU validation backlog. Mitigation: restrict initial matrix to int8 + conservative cache heuristics.

li - ML: Note: caching + quant interactions need explicit tests for long-context models; tag cached contexts in telemetry.

anya - PM: Thanks. Keep the playbook lean and instrumented. We'll iterate after pilot telemetry. :thumbsup:
